en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide sandy open field with many people strolling and gathering in the distance. In the foreground are adults and children dressed in late‑19th or early‑20th‑century clothing, including long dark dresses and hats. Hills or a shoreline are visible in the far background. The caption at the bottom reads "La Coruña — Campo de la Estrada," and there is a handwritten signature in the lower right. Along the left margin appears the printer's information printed vertically.
